title: Reject rollouts when independent traces disagree
narrative: Nubble needs executor events and gateway capture to reconcile before a rollout is accepted for training or self-improvement. Accepts FineEnvs independent trajectory checks[^fineenvs-reconcile]. Trace reconciliation for Dots MH-DOTS-09[^insp-dots-09-recon].
implementation: `ObservationSurface`, `reconcile_traces`, and `require_reconciled` in `mechaharness.trace_reconciliation` compare event ids and digests across surfaces.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `trace_reconciliation_check.yaml`. Hard expects on declared observation keys.
